subject: Renewal alignment + one-time burst cushion for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal alignment + one-time burst cushion for Nimbus Health

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our discussion, I’m sending a concise renewal proposal that aligns the annual commitment to your expected run rate for FY29, and adds a one-time burst cushion to cover the planned Q4 analytics spike without renegotiating the commit later. High level: 

- Term: 12 months (start 2028-07-01)
- Annual committed spend: $420k (unchanged from forecast submission)
- One-time burst buffer: 250k tokens usable over a 30-day window in Q4 (billed if exceeded at overage rate)
- Billing: prefer to route via AWS Private Offer so you get consolidated invoicing and the Marketplace listing remains active

I’ve attached a PO template and will follow with a Private Offer draft for your procurement team to review. Can you confirm: (1) internal signatory for POs, and (2) whether you need the contract split into two tranches for fiscal reasons? If you share the PO template back I’ll send a doc with the exact private-offer terms for your finance/legal to redline.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

—
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
David.Kim@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: Nimbus_PO_Template.docx (stub)

From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@nimbushealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal alignment + one-time burst cushion for Nimbus Health

David —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Procurement and finance reviewed your bullets and have two immediate asks:

1) We need the Private Offer to include a split-invoicing option (50/50 by quarter) — our fiscal team requires tranche-level invoices for the new fiscal calendar.
2) We will accept a 30-day burst window but would like a cap on the maximum billable overage (no more than 3x the overage rate over the cushion) — is that something Redwood can commit to?

I attached our PO template and the SOW summary our legal wants to include. We prefer to keep the Marketplace flow (AWS Private Offer) because it simplifies procurement approval. If you can send a Private Offer draft with the tranche billing and an overage cap, we’ll route internally. We aim to have sign-off by 2028-06-15 if possible.

—Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Health
sarah.lewis@nimbushealth.com

Attachments: Nimbus_PO_Template.docx (attached), NIM_SOW_Summary.pdf (attached)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-05T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal alignment + one-time burst cushion for Nimbus Health

David —

Quick internal note before we send the Private Offer: procurement asks are reasonable. Two negotiation points to keep in mind when drafting the PO/offer: 

- Tranche invoicing: we can support 50/50 invoice splits but need to ensure the Marketplace private-offer flow still maps to the invoice timeline; Marissa, can you validate the AWS invoicing mapping?
- Overage cap: we are OK to set a soft cap on billable overage to protect their budget, but we should reserve the right to convert extreme sustained usage into an uplifted committed tier (i.e., if usage exceeds cushion + 30 days at >80% of burst for two weeks straight). I'll summarize the recommended language below for the redline.

Recommended redline summary to include in Private_Offer_Draft: 
- Add clause: "Burst cushion is a one-time allowance of 250k tokens during a 30-day window; charges for usage beyond cushion are billed at the agreed overage rate but capped at 3x the standard overage for that 30-day window; extended high usage may trigger commit uplift discussions."
- Add schedule: "Invoices will be issued in two equal tranches aligned to the customer fiscal quarters; AWS PO acceptance will be linked to the signed Private Offer."

I will produce the Private_Offer_Draft-Redline.pdf and send to you to upload to the DocuSign/Marketplace flow.

Laura
Director, Cloud Marketplace Deals
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Private_Offer_Draft-Redline.pdf (will upload)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-06T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal alignment + one-time burst cushion for Nimbus Health

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — attached is the Private Offer draft with the two items you requested implemented: tranche invoicing language and the 3x overage cap for the burst window. Key callouts: 

- The burst buffer clause includes the 3x cap and an escalation path (we will not retroactively bill above the cap; instead, extended overages trigger a commit uplift conversation for sustained demand).
- Invoice schedule will issue two equal invoices via the AWS Marketplace billing flow; we’ve added the AWS PO acceptance mapping in the Private Offer so your procurement can reconcile.

I’ve uploaded the package to DocuSign and attached the embedded link here: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/example/NIM-4721 (DocuSign will contain the Private Offer + PO). If you can confirm the PO signatory (name and title) and target the 2028-06-15 sign-by date, I’ll queue the Private Offer for AWS acceptance.

Thanks — happy to join your procurement review call if you want us there.

—
David

Attachment: Private_Offer_Draft-Redline.pdf (stub)
Link: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/example/NIM-4721

From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@nimbushealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-07T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal alignment + one-time burst cushion for Nimbus Health

David / Laura —

Confirmed — our CFO signed the PO this afternoon. We completed the DocuSign flow and attached the signed PO for your records. Procurement will accept the Private Offer via AWS Marketplace once Redwood confirms the offer id maps to our contract number.

Signed PO attached: Signed_PO_Nimbus_20280607.pdf
DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/example/NIM-4721

Next steps on our side: procurement will route the AWS Private Offer acceptance to AWS marketplace billing and send you the acceptance receipt (we’ll copy Marissa). Please let us know when the Marketplace acceptance shows active and we’ll schedule the onboarding handoff for the Q4 burst plan.

—Sarah
Sarah Lewis
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Health

Attachment: Signed_PO_Nimbus_20280607.pdf (stub)
